title: Growing Prefix Span
statementMd:
For a permutation of 1,2,…,n, let si be the length of the **shortest contiguous subarray** containing all values 1,2,…,i.

Let posp(x) be the position of x in the permutation; we have

si=max1≤x≤iposp(x)−min1≤x≤iposp(x)+1.

For each i, an interval constraint [li,ri] is given.

Please count the permutations satisfying li≤si≤ri for every i. Print the answer modulo 998244353.

## Input

The first line contains an integer n (1≤n≤2⋅105).

Each of the next n lines contains two integers li and ri (1≤li≤ri≤n).

## Output

Print the number of valid permutations modulo 998244353.

Please note that a valid permutation may not exist.

## Note

The valid permutations in the example are (1,2,3), (2,1,3), (3,1,2), and (3,2,1).
